entries.name: George Greene

expected_cases.charges: Arrest during a Greenwood demonstration; exact statutory charge unverified
expected_cases.sentence: Six-month hard-labor sentence and $500 fine; the interview-based history reports 67 days actually served before his father obtained release. Custody included county farm and Parchman; exact endpoints unverified.

expected_cases.charges: Initially held for auto-theft investigation; subsequently charged with speeding
expected_cases.sentence: Thirty hours detained with MacArthur Cotton during voter-registration work in Natchez in late February 1964. Exact days and disposition unverified.

updates.charges: Traffic allegation: making a U-turn (Jackson, Mississippi)
updates.sentence: SNCC WATS report dated March 26, 1964 records an overnight arrest in Jackson for making a U-turn, a $22 fine, and release on March 26. This is distinct from his February Natchez detention with MacArthur Cotton and his 1963 Parchman confinement.

entries.rationale: March 26, 1964 SNCC WATS report, Jackson paragraph, dates arrest to the preceding night and release to the report day. Original single-page scan inspected. One elapsed calendar day, not a claim of 24 full hours. Existing episodes preserved.
